name: vibedev_rail_reply_no_coding_lead
content: I can't start a build: no coding lead is configured for this deployment (`coding.lead_agent_id` in magician-config.yaml is unset).
`@vibedev` will not pick an owner for a coding run on its own — an arbitrary agent would accept the task and then be unable to do it. Set the lead in config and try again.

metadata.description: Assistant reply when a `@vibedev` chat turn cannot resolve an owner because coding.lead_agent_id is unset. No task is created. Fail-closed: the cockpit can fall back to a client-sent agent id, but the chat rail has no client value to fall back to and must not invent one.
metadata.author: magician
